command reference

devopsgen detect

Inspect the current project and report what DevOpsGen would scaffold for it: the programming stack, the exact files that shaped the decision, and the candidate application types.

Reading the output

LineMeaning
stack: goThe detected programming stack (go or nodejs).
indicators: go.mod, ...The files that produced evidence — your audit trail for why the stack matched.
app-type candidates: binaryApplication types plausible for this project; the wizard default comes from here too.

How it decides

  • Go — go.mod and its module directive looking like module example.com/app.
  • Node.js — package.json, plus its dependencies, and lockfile flavours (npm / pnpm) that later steer Docker image commands.
  • Ambiguity or zero indicators produce a distinct exit code (5) so scripts can branch safely — see exit codes.
Detection semantics: DevOpsGen detects in the current working directory, not in --output-dir. Run it from the project you want scanned.
